import numpy as np
best=[]
for w in np.linspace(0.05,3,300):
    cols=[]
    for g in [np.ones_like(t), t, np.sin(w*t), np.cos(w*t)]:
        for p in [np.ones_like(P),P,P**2]:
            cols.append(g*p)
    A=np.array(cols).T
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    nm=np.mean((A@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    best.append((nm,w))
best.sort()
print(best[:5])

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s1=np.sqrt(1+t); s0=np.sqrt(t)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3
            + s1*(p[4]*np.sqrt(P)+p[5]*P)
            + s0*(p[6]*P+p[7]*P**2+p[8]*P*np.log(P))
            + p[9]*t*np.log(P))
